definitions.explanation: A statement that makes something clear.

notes:
{説明|せつめい} means explanation or description. As a verbal noun, it forms {説明|せつめい}する (to explain).

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- No standard intransitive pair
- Pattern: [noun]を{説明|せつめい}する

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {説明|せつめい}する: to explain
- {説明|せつめい}を{聞|き}く: to listen to an explanation
- {説明|せつめい}を{受|う}ける: to receive an explanation
- ～について{説明|せつめい}する: to explain about ~

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {説明書|せつめいしょ}: instruction manual
- {説明会|せつめいかい}: information session, briefing
- {自己|じこ}{説明|せつめい}: self-explanation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {解説|かいせつ}: commentary, detailed explanation
- {紹介|しょうかい}: introduction
- {案内|あんない}: guidance, information

The phrase {説明|せつめい}が{足|た}りない (explanation is insufficient) is common for expressing that something wasn't explained well enough.
